### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Only report symptoms or their explicit denial. Do not infer the absence of a symptom from the denial of a related one.
[O-Section]: For physical exam findings, use only exact descriptors from the transcript (e.g., 'present' vs. 'normal'). Do not infer qualities or normalcy.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Report only symptoms or their *explicit* denial. If a symptom is mentioned by the provider but not explicitly affirmed or denied by the patient, *omit* any mention of it. Do not infer the absence of a symptom from the denial of a related one.
